title: Tutor Homework Closure Rate
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:tutor tutor_name=* homework_closed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(homework_closed="yes",1,0))) as matched by tutor_name
| eval closed_homework_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - closed_homework_pct
description: Measures the percentage of tutor homework items that end with closed homework by tutor.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which tutor are helping or hurting tutor homework items.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `closed homework` on `language:tutor` events and summarize the hit rate by `tutor_name`.
visualization: Table of tutor with percentage of tutor homework items ending with closed homework.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often closed homework happens for each tutor so you can see where tutor homework items go smoothly or get stuck.
